title: Sound-effect packs and procedural SFX generators
description: UI clicks, impacts, footsteps, coins and whooshes for shorts and Godot scenes: Kenney's CC0 audio packs, CC0 retro packs on OpenGameArt, and open-source generators (ZzFX, jsfxr, rFXGen, Bfxr) that let an agent synthesise original effects with no third-party sample in the chain.

items.title: Kenney audio packs (category)
items.summary: All Kenney audio packs: Casino Audio, Sci-fi Sounds, Interface Sounds, Impact Sounds, Voiceover Pack, Music Jingles, RPG Audio, Digital Audio, UI Audio. All CC0.

items.title: Kenney Interface Sounds
items.summary: Clicks, toggles, confirmations and errors for UI and caption pops, CC0.

items.title: Kenney RPG Audio (50 files)
items.summary: 50 foley sounds: footsteps, weapons, doors, coins (released 2014), CC0.

items.title: Kenney Casino Audio
items.summary: Card, chip and dice sounds for game-show and 'this vs that' reveal moments, CC0.

items.title: Kenney Voiceover Pack
items.summary: Announcer-style spoken game words (start, go, game over ...), CC0.

items.title: 512 Sound Effects (8-bit style) by SubspaceAudio
items.summary: 512 NES/C64-style retro effects (part of the 1000 Retro Sound Effects pack sold on itch.io), CC0 on OpenGameArt.

items.title: 8-Bit Sound Effect Pack (OpenGameArt)
items.summary: Another retro sound-effect pack on OpenGameArt.
cautions: Licence not confirmed in search results; read the page before use.

items.title: ZzFX (tiny JavaScript sound FX system)
items.summary: Under-1 KB JS synth with 20 parameters per sound (zzfx(...params)); MIT. An agent can store a parameter array instead of an audio file and render it offline.

items.title: jsfxr (sfxr in JavaScript)
items.summary: Quick game sound-effect generator (pickup, laser, explosion, jump ...) usable in the browser or as a library; Unlicense.
cautions: The repo licence covers the code; it does not state terms for generated sounds. Generated output from your own parameters is normally treated as yours, but record the generator and parameters.

items.title: rFXGen (raylib sound FX generator)
items.summary: Desktop/web sfx generator with a CLI: presets (coin, laser, explosion, powerup, hit, jump, blip), batch .rfx to WAV, 22.05/44.1 kHz, 8/16/32-bit; source under zlib/libpng.
cautions: Licence covers the software; terms for generated sounds are not stated on the page.

items.title: Bfxr (sfxr-based effects generator)
items.summary: Flash/AIR sound-effect generator based on sfxr; Apache 2.0.
cautions: Legacy Flash/AIR codebase; prefer jsfxr or rFXGen for automated pipelines.
